channel.description: Latest articles from The Real News (therealnews.com)

item.title: The AI bubble, like the housing bubble, is a big problem and it’s not complicated
item.description: There is a tremendous premium in intellectual circles on making the AI bubble problem more complicated than it is.

item.title: Fisherwoman Diane Wilson is on hunger strike to stop Dow’s pollution of Texas Gulf Coast
item.description: “We're saying, ‘Oh, pretty please, will you save the bays? Will you not pollute us today?’... I think we're way too polite and way too well-behaved. And that's why I advocate being an unreasonable woman.”

item.title: AI-powered robot dogs guarding reviled data centers is where we have arrived
item.description: These robots, known as “quadrupeds,” are being used to patrol the sprawling energy-sucking complexes, which are increasingly being met with protest around the country.

item.title: Israel urges Iranian uprising while privately saying they’d 'get slaughtered'
item.description: Israeli officials told US diplomats that the Iranian government is “not cracking” in a State Department cable.

item.title: ICE deporting parents without allowing them to bring or find care for children: report
item.description: Federal immigration agents are required to allow parents to “make alternative care arrangements” for their children before they’re detained.

item.title: ‘Beyond the pale’: general says US military will create a ‘camp’ at Gitmo to ‘deal with’ Cubans fleeing Trump blockade
item.description: One foreign policy expert noted that fears of a “mass exodus” of refugees come “as the US starves Cuba of energy and food.”

item.title: Yanis Varoufakis knows who's going to lose the war in Iran
item.description: “The vast majority of Americans, Europeans, Iranians, of people in the Global South, who now see increases in the price of food because fertilizers are going up, because oil is going up, because natural gas is going up—the workers of the world are united in being the losers of this war.”

item.title: Start the steal? Inside Trump's effort to rig the midterm elections
item.description: “As the president becomes more unpopular, his actions will become more extreme, but that doesn't mean they're going to be any more successful,” Ari Berman of Mother Jones tells us.

item.title: Meet the data analysts exposing ICE's plans
item.description: “If you understand what an organization like ICE is doing, and you can quantify it… you can resist effectively,” says Michael Wriston of Project Salt Box.

item.title: From former slave to anarchist: Lucy Parsons' radical life and legacy
item.description: “She was very much ahead of her time… this is a formerly enslaved Black woman who was speaking with an unfettered, unrestrained radicalism.”
